_doc: How a control drives generative mode (any control input: the device's knob, a key, later an external MIDI controller). Keys starting with _ are comments.
_settle_ms: An encoder turn ends after this long without movement; then it runs.
_units_per_level: How many encoder increments make one more level of intensity (1, 2, 3, ...: more notes change).
_max_level: The most intensity (or undo steps) one turn can give.
_left: Turning counter-clockwise: "undo" steps back through the runs (one per level), "vary" runs as clockwise does.
_debounce_ms: Button presses closer than this count as one (a chord on the keys).
